scope: Local implementation of the F11-01 internal multi-Pine run store, slice RS-1 (RD-MP-2 option B, RD-MP-19): the offline extension mp-run-store with two insert-only tables, guards, classifier, rollback, CLI, an internal_only grant category and an isolated-cluster fixture grant script. No writer, service, route or worker; nothing is installed on any environment.
method: An architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) wrote the run-store design and root decided it. A coder (Sonnet 5.5) wrote RS-1; an independent architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) reviewed it and showed by probes that inheritance or a view could expose runs to the runtime role while the classifier still reported INSTALLED; root ruled; the coder added the checks; an independent tester (Sonnet 5.5) ran single-edit mutations after each round. A sole-runner tester then ran, with nothing else active, every test file that imports a changed module or reads the changed grant script (found with git grep): 24 PostgreSQL files one file per process on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster (441 tests, 0 fail; 2 skipped by platform gates in a file this batch did not change), the full unit suite (2313 tests, 0 fail, 6 skipped by platform gates, 9 todo) and the grant text test; every changed file had the same hash before and after. A first attempt at that pass stopped early and was rerun in full. Nobody verified their own work.
hashNote: SHA-256 of the line-feed content as Git stores it.
result: test/postgres/mp-run-store.test.mjs 31 of 31, test/postgres/mp-member-set.test.mjs 23 of 23 and test/postgres/runtime-grants.test.mjs 1 of 1 pass with 0 skipped; the grant text test passes 2 of 2.

mutations.round2: 9 of 9 killed (inheritance, outside foreign key, publication and dependent-view checks, the marker privilege check, and the deadline minimum and maximum).

limits: Isolated clusters only until the owner decides O1; the run store is never installed on staging or production before APP-3B.
On an isolated cluster the runtime role still sees table statistics (row counts), and a users delete of a fixture owner fails on the run-store key.
No writer, service, route or worker uses the tables yet (RS-2 onward).
No install was run on any environment.
Some mutants were killed only by the classifier definition pin (the test that pins the installed definitions), not by a behaviour test; that is weaker evidence than a behaviour kill.

rootAcceptance.statement: Root reviewed the agent reports, the rulings, the sole-runner verification and the final diff and accepted RS-1 as local engineering evidence for F11-01. Acceptance changes no PM-1 credit by itself and deploys nothing.
